Theorem
[Ricci lower bound with injectivity control]

Source: petersen:page-0449 ↗ def:pet-ch11-harmonic-norm 1. ch11:11.4.15For $R,k>0$ and $\alpha \in (0,1)$, there are suitable $Q,r$ depending on $n,R,k$ such that any $(M^n,g)$ with $\Ric \ge -(n-1)k^2$, $\inj \ge R$ satisfies $\| (M,g)\| ^{\mathrm{har}}_{C^{\alpha },r}\le Q$.
